description: Statistics Poland publishes national transport statistics in its transport and communications area. The publication "Żegluga śródlądowa w Polsce" (inland navigation in Poland) appears every two years and includes information on inland waterways, the inland fleet, freight and passenger carriage, the economics of inland shipping enterprises, employment and accidents, with domestic and international carriage by cargo group and distance zone and breakdowns by voivodeship; editions go back to 2014 in the archive, the latest covering 2022 and 2023 (published 7 October 2024), and a separate report covers inland water transport in 2023. The monthly socio-economic situation report gives preliminary freight carried by road, rail, pipeline and sea: in August 2026 road transport carried 20.5 million tonnes, rail 18.6 million tonnes and pipelines 5.0 million tonnes. Coverage is Poland. Access: free PDF publications with statistical tables and web tables on the GUS websites. Caveats: the monthly figures are preliminary and some series are suppressed for statistical confidentiality, and the inland navigation data are biennial. It supports freight demand and modal split analysis, inland waterway capacity studies and calibration of national freight models, and complements the Eurostat transport statistics and the Polish inland waterways portal catalogued here.
